This freestanding toilet paper stand features a European-style hook for fast, simple roll changes and a heavy base designed to help prevent tipping.

Highlights:
- Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stay stable on the floor—heavy base helps prevent tipping
- Coordinate a classic look—traditional design in the Carolina collection
- Built for lasting use—crafted from solid brass

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand (toilet paper stand)
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Included: Toilet tissue stand
